pages.text: Your Vault Potion $(l)heals you$() and applies the $(l)effects$() in its slots.$(br2)It lives in the $(l)Potion slot$() next to your Companion slot. Only the potion in that slot works in a Vault, and it stays there until you leave.$(br2)Leaving a Vault refills it, and so does opening your Alchemy Station.

pages.title: Vault Potion
pages.text: Your first one comes from the $(l)Vault Potions$() quest. A lost one is crafted again from a glass bottle and a chromatic iron ingot.

pages.title: Charges
pages.text: $(br)Inside a Vault one fill bar refills your charges from $(l)kills$() (bigger mobs count more) and $(l)vault chests$(). Every refill in the same Vault costs a bit more than the one before, and higher Vaults need more.$(br2)Drinking is instant and has a $(l)4 second$() cooldown.

pages.title: Drink Mode
pages.text: $(br)Right-click the potion in its slot to switch:$(br)$(li)$(l)Below 25% health$() (default)$(li)$(l)Below 50% health$()$(li)$(l)Manual Key$()$(br2)Below the threshold the potion drinks itself. The Drink key is unbound, set it in Controls.

pages.title: Tiers
pages.text: $(br)Researching $(l)Potions$(), $(l)Mixtures$() and $(l)Brews$() upgrades your potion on its own:$(br)$(li)$(l)Vial$(): 4 charges, 1 slot$(li)$(l)Potion$(): 5 charges, 2 slots$(li)$(l)Mixture$(): 6 charges, 3 slots$(li)$(l)Brew$(): 7 charges, 4 slots$(br2)Every charge heals 6 Hit Points.
